about: Benjamin I. Fink is a top-rated attorney practicing in the Atlanta, Georgia area. Providing legal representation in Georgia for a variety of different issues, Benjamin Fink was selected to Super Lawyers for 2005 - 2027.

After completing undergraduate studies, Benjamin I. Fink attended law school. Benjamin Fink was enrolled at Emory University School of Law. He earned a juris doctor degree in 1992. Benjamin Fink was admitted to the practice of law in 1992.

Attorneys like Benjamin I. Fink are recognized by their peers for their outstanding work and commitment to the spirit of the legal profession. Their knowledge of the law, professional work ethic, and advocacy on behalf of their clients allow them to stand out among other attorneys in the field.
Benjamin Fink represents clients with Business Litigation issues. Additional legal issues represented include Employment Litigation: Defense.
